body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea EINSTEIN RING FLASH: the body is a calm, deep matte black monolith, the shadow. The only light on it is milky translucent white inlay, flush with the surface: from the flash window three thin rays curve round like the bent rays in image[2] and merge into one thin glowing ring round the lens, as in image[3], with a recessed black annulus between ring and lens. The ring is the flash diffuser, a ring light. image[4] = sculpted black body with stepped top plate, tone on tone. image[5] = only knurled pads and machined edges. Diamond-knurled black grip pad front left, satin graphite shutter with collar, two translucent light-pipe dots on top, engraved ticks, bottom vent slots, plug cover with exhaust slots on the left end, corner eyelet, shadow-gap seam. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
